styles.melody_harmony: Original soulful melodies, expressive harmonies and developing chorus contours with a gradual emotional rise.
styles.vocal_delivery: Sincere soulful storytelling and expressive melodic phrasing with rich supporting choir harmonies; the selected voice remains independent.
styles.arrangement: Begin with gentle piano and an emotionally meaningful verse. Expand into a melodic chorus with warm harmonies, gradually adding strings and fuller instrumentation. Develop an expressive bridge before the concluding chorus.

lyrics.structure: Sincere meaningful storytelling about gratitude, divine faithfulness, personal testimony, mercy, hope and God's enduring love, with clear emotional progression.
lyrics.vocabulary: Natural original testimony and thankful language with coherent emotional development rather than generic repetition.

styles.production_mix: Keep piano expressive, strings warm, pads atmospheric, bass smooth, live drums gentle and electric guitar subtle; let rich choir harmonies develop without masking the storytelling.

introductions: Begin with gentle open piano voicings before the meaningful verse.
Begin with gentle close piano voicings and a different expressive introduction.
progressions: Use original heartfelt harmonic movement through the verse and chorus.
Use alternate original piano voicings and harmonic movement toward the bridge.
arrangements: Introduce warm strings gradually, then develop an expressive bridge before the final chorus.
Vary string entrances and bridge structure while preserving the gradual emotional rise.
melody: Create an original soulful chorus melody with developing choir harmonies.
Create a contrasting original chorus contour supported by a different warm string arrangement.
lyrical: Tell an original personal testimony of mercy, hope and gratitude.
Develop a sincere original story of divine faithfulness and God's enduring love.

styles.name: Radiant Hope
styles.description: Peaceful, encouraging Gospel with warm piano, acoustic guitar textures and gentle African percussion.
styles.mood: Peaceful, hopeful, encouraging and spiritually refreshing.
styles.energy: Gentle engaging movement develops through subtle layers and harmonies into a reassuring final chorus.
styles.rhythm: Gentle but engaging contemporary African Gospel rhythm with flowing bass movement and restrained percussion.
styles.drums_percussion: Light live drums and gentle African percussion supporting restrained rhythmic movement.
styles.bass: Melodic bass guitar with a flowing supportive character.

instruments.keys: Soft contemporary keyboards and warm piano.
instruments.guitar: Acoustic guitar textures supporting the gentle Afro-contemporary rhythm.
instruments.other: Soft layered backing harmonies and subtle instrumental layers.

styles.melody_harmony: Original expressive worship melodies and uplifting choruses with natural meaningful melodic development.
styles.vocal_delivery: Clear natural encouraging melodic phrasing and soft supporting harmonies; voice is chosen independently.
styles.arrangement: Begin with a warm instrumental introduction and clear melodic verse. Build toward an uplifting chorus through subtle instrumental layers and harmonies. Include a short instrumental passage before a reassuring final chorus.

lyrics.structure: Hope, divine comfort, healing, trust, faithfulness, encouragement and God's love in natural meaningful and emotionally clear lyrics.
lyrics.vocabulary: Original emotionally clear words of comfort and encouragement; do not force Pidgin or any other language unless selected.

styles.production_mix: Keep keyboards soft, piano warm, bass melodic, drums light, African percussion gentle and acoustic guitar textured; let soft backing harmonies support a spiritually refreshing, reassuring finish.

introductions: Begin with warm piano and soft contemporary keyboards.
Begin with gentle acoustic-guitar textures answered by warm piano.
progressions: Use an original hopeful chorus progression with flowing melodic bass.
Use an alternate original uplifting progression with a different warm piano pattern.
arrangements: Add subtle layers and harmonies before a short instrumental passage and reassuring final chorus.
Keep early layers sparse, then vary the instrumental passage and final chorus harmonies.
melody: Create an original encouraging chorus melody over gentle guitar textures.
Create a contrasting original uplifting chorus contour with different bass and piano responses.
lyrical: Develop original words of hope, comfort, healing and trust.
Develop encouragement, faithfulness and God's love in natural emotionally clear verses.
